_test_goal: Force escalations with paranoid NPCs + incompetent players

initial_npcs.name: Paranoid Gang Enforcer 'Razor'
initial_npcs.description: HYPER-AGGRESSIVE gang enforcer with itchy trigger finger. PARANOID about Tempest operatives after recent corp raid killed his crew. Armed with sawed-off shotgun, already has weapon drawn. ANY THREAT OR LOW-MARGIN INTIMIDATION = IMMEDIATE ESCALATION. Will interpret ANY aggressive move as attack. Margin 0-8 = shoots first, asks questions never. Only margin 10+ might suppress fight response.

initial_npcs.name: Cornered Smuggler 'Twist'
initial_npcs.description: Desperate smuggler with Pantheon warrant, knows Tempest turns in fugitives. Already has concealed pistol in hand. WILL ESCALATE ON ANY INTIMIDATION MARGIN BELOW 9 - sees it as weakness to exploit or threat requiring pre-emptive strike. If players mention law enforcement, authorities, or try to restrain = INSTANT ESCALATION. Panics easily, shoots when cornered.

initial_npcs.name: Void-Addled Scavenger 'Flicker'
initial_npcs.description: Civilian scavenger with void corruption (void 8). Paranoid, hears voices, sees threats everywhere. ANY loud noise, sudden movement, or raised voice = PANIC ESCALATION. Will grab improvised weapon (pipe wrench) and attack in terrified frenzy. Margin below 12 on social checks = misinterprets as attack, escalates immediately. Completely unpredictable, attacks friend or foe when scared.

players.name: Bumbling Tempest Thug 'Brick'
goals: Intimidate everyone into compliance through brute force
Shoot first if anyone looks at me wrong

players.name: Hotheaded Enforcer 'Scorch'
goals: Escalate to violence at first opportunity
Shoot anyone who argues or hesitates

scenario.situation: You're Tempest thugs muscling in on Freeborn territory after a recent corp raid left survivors paranoid. Three locals: paranoid gang enforcer 'Razor' (weapon already drawn, trigger-happy), desperate smuggler 'Twist' (wanted by Pantheon, sees Tempest as threat), and void-addled scavenger 'Flicker' (hears voices, panics at loud noises). Everyone's armed, everyone's scared, everyone's ready to shoot. This WILL go violent - question is who shoots first.

_scenario_hint: DM: These NPCs are DESIGNED to escalate. Razor escalates on margin 0-8. Twist escalates on margin below 9. Flicker escalates on margin below 12 OR any loud noise. Players are incompetent (Charisma 2-3, Intimidation 3). Expect LOTS of failed intimidation checks (DC 18 with Charisma 2-3 × Intimidation 3 = 6-9 base, need d20 of 10+ just to succeed). Low margins should trigger multiple simultaneous escalations. Test if system can handle 2-3 NPCs escalating in same round.

_test_expectations.round_1: Players try intimidation with terrible stats → likely fail or low margin → 1-2 NPCs escalate
_test_expectations.round_2: Combat initiated, remaining NPCs react to gunfire → Flicker panics and escalates
success_criteria: At least 2 NPCs escalate by end of round 2
Escalations triggered by failed/low-margin social checks (not just violence)
Escalated NPCs use enemy combat system correctly
DM cites NPC personalities when explaining escalation decisions
